title: Community Soda Kiln Firing
bring: bisque-fired work, up to 2 cubic feet (12"x12"x12" box equivalent) per person; work must be cone 6 rated, no larger than 12" tall or wide
cost_text: $75 per cubic foot of space; maximum 2 shares per person
commitment: Glaze and wad work at designated glazing time before loading; pick up work after firing
how_to_join: Link to sign up for glazing time slot sent one week prior to loading date
source_quote: Upcoming Soda Kiln Firing Dates: April 14th, May 13th, June 17th
evidence_sentence: The soda kiln firing page lists three dated community firings for 2026 and specifies costs, capacity, and bring requirements.
evidence_quote: The cost for a share in the community soda firing is $75.00 for 1 cubic foot of space. There is a maximum of 2 shares per person.
summary: Participate in community soda kiln firings on April 14, May 13, or June 17, 2026. Bring bisque-fired work (up to 2 cubic feet per person, cone 6 rated), participate in a glazing session one week before loading, and pick up after firing. Cost is $75 per cubic foot.
